title: Where does the water go?
question: If you warm up seawater, where does the water go?
steps: Press and hold the sun over the sea with your finger.
Watch the vapor rise from the sea and become a cloud, and the cloud grow until it rains.
Use the button at the bottom left to switch between a weak sun and a strong sun.
observe: When the sun warms the sea, water turns into vapor and rises into the sky. High up the vapor cools into tiny drops that make a cloud, and when the drops grow big they fall as rain. The stronger the sun, the more water evaporates and the more it rains.

terms.name: Evaporation
terms.description: Water warming up and rising into the air as invisible vapor.

terms.name: Water vapor
terms.description: Water as a gas. You can't see it.

terms.name: Cloud
terms.description: Tiny drops of water gathered high in the sky, where the vapor cooled down.

terms.name: Rain
terms.description: Drops in a cloud that grew big and heavy and fall to the ground.

law.equation: evaporation → cloud → rain → back to the sea
law.title: The water cycle
law.description: When the sun warms water, it turns into vapor and rises into the sky. Up there the vapor cools into a cloud, and when the cloud's drops grow big they come down as rain. The rain flows into rivers and the sea and rises again. Water goes round and round.

tip: Press and hold the sun over the sea with one finger: the sun warms the sea. Let go and it stops; press again and it goes on. When the sun bar runs out, the day is over. Press Start over for a new day.
tip_short: Press and hold the sun to warm the sea

predict.question: If you warm up seawater, where does the water go?
predict.reason: Warm water turns into vapor and rises into the sky. You just can't see it.
predict.bridge: Shine the sun and see for yourself!

stages.text: Press and hold the sun to warm the sea and make one cloud!
stages.say: When the sun warms the sea, vapor rises. High in the sky it is cold, so the vapor turns into tiny drops. The drops gather into a cloud.

stages.text: Grow the cloud until it rains!
stages.say: When the drops gather and grow big, they can't float in the sky any more. Then they fall as rain.
stages.miss: Hold it so the cloud grows!

stages.text: Switch to the strong sun and fill the pond to the top!
stages.say: The stronger the sun, the more water evaporates. More clouds grow and more rain falls.
stages.win: The pond is full! The piece floated up!

story.keeper: This was the frogs' pond. No rain came, and it dried up to the bottom…
story.clue: The frogs must be so thirsty… Huh? There's a piece stuck in the dry bottom!
story.clue_more: If the pond fills up, I think the piece will float up.
story.map_clue: By the sea, where the dry pond is!

kid.intro: This is the water journey lab. When the sun warms water, it turns into invisible vapor and rises into the sky. This is called **evaporation**.

intro_more.text: Up in the sky the vapor cools into clouds, and it comes back down to the ground as rain. Water goes round and round like this.

kid.title: Press the sun and warm the sea!
kid.say: When the sun warms the sea, water turns into vapor and rises. Up high it cools into a cloud, and when the cloud grows big it rains.
kid.tip: Press and hold the sun to warm the sea.

note.law: When the sun warms water, it rises as vapor, cools into a cloud up high, and comes back down as rain. The stronger the sun, the more evaporates.
